name: QVODTUES
source:
QVODTUES is a short, atmospheric "sound novel" about two lonely, yet parallel, people.

Play as Eunice, an alien excited to get to Earth, hug the dogs, and make her family proud.
Play as Leone, an old farmer who just wants his quiet life, his cattle, and his dog, McDonald.

The sacrifices, or lack of, made for what we love.
